description: This file provides utility functions for formatting strings within a web application, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for display purposes. It is used across the project to ensure consistent string normalization, particularly for UI components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace, returning the transformed string suitable for variable naming.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case suitable for display, handling delimiters like underscores and hyphens, collapsing whitespace, and capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes.
